267007|7413cdc8.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|7413cdc8.text: All of a sudden you're a 'Defender of the Alliance' are you?! Well, I suppose you'll be wanting to head to the Champions' Hall now. It's over in Old Town, but they won't let you in unless you're an officer, so you might just have to settle for talking to Officer Areyn outside. Move along now.

6727|0f322cd8.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|0f322cd8.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity; the upper courtyards are what you seek.

6727|29b91ff4.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|29b91ff4.text: The old Assembly of Thanes is a chamber below the great city of Ironforge, the ancestral home of the Bronzebeard clan. Its depths plunge to the deepest parts of the heart of Khaz Modan, and rumor has it immense geodes crown the chamber.

6727|a9b2021a.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|a9b2021a.text: The Hall of Thanes is sealed off. Those without audience to King Magni Bronzebeard must earn his trust and approval to venture into the depths of old Ironforge.

6727|c3a29bdb.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c3a29bdb.text:
Our ancient lands are in the northeast of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and offers many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately, its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity, but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.

116-accept.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-accept.text:
I find myself in quite a pinch here, $N.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.

Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the $N hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-accept.title: Dry Times

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

14-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-complete.text: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for $N yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.
14-complete.title: The People's Militia

141-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
141-accept.text:
The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.

I have written a more detailed account for your Master in $N.  Take this to him at once!
141-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-accept.text: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of $N that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
166-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

92747-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92747-accept.text:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of $N, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $N, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747-accept.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92748-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92748-accept.text:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of $N. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92751-accept.name: Jasper Fel
92751-accept.text:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.

If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below $N, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.

Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
92751-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

97220-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97220-progress.text: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220-progress.title: Philmor's Favor
